site.name: SRE Maturity Self-Assessment
site.description: A 20-question, 5-minute SRE maturity self-assessment. It measures governance and behavior, not tools.

landing.lead: This assessment measures how your team governs and practices reliability, not which tools it runs. Installing Prometheus does not make you mature.
landing.detail: 20 questions, about 5 minutes. You get a level for each of six dimensions, the gap between what you describe and what last happened, and next steps ordered by prerequisites.

disclaimer: This assessment is a starting point for self-reflection, not an audit. Self-assessment is always biased; evidence questions and gap hints reduce that bias but cannot remove it. Treat the results as material for a team conversation, not as a grade.

start.title: Before you begin
start.lead: These three choices shape how questions are worded and what we suggest. Team size and service type are not scored.

manager.label: Manager / architect
manager.desc: Questions ask about the organization and its mechanisms; suggestions focus on governance.

engineer.label: Engineer
engineer.desc: Questions ask about your own experience; suggestions are small steps you can take this week.

start.required: Please make all three choices to continue.

question.evidence: Evidence question: answer with what actually happened last time
question.scenario: Pick the description closest to your team today
question.keyboard: Use number keys to choose, Enter to continue

contact.title: One last step before your results
contact.lead: Enter your name and email to see your results. You will get:

bullets.result: Your full results and ordered recommendations
bullets.share: A shareable summary link (no personal data)
bullets.later: Possibly a deeper analysis sent to you later

results.title: Your results
results.capped: Your overall score maps to {{raw}}, but the overall level is held back by the "{{dims}}" dimension: the overall level can be at most one level above the weakest dimension. When one dimension is broken, high scores elsewhere cannot represent the whole.
results.radarAlt: Radar chart: self-reported and evidence-calibrated lines across six dimensions, scale 1 to 4. The same data is in the table below.
results.nextLevel: What the next level looks like
results.smallTeamSkip: Small teams can skip this: this level is rarely worth it for teams under 5 people.
results.gap: Your description is more optimistic than your most recent example.
results.gapsLead: You answered "unsure" or "no data" on these questions. They count as 1: a mechanism that exists but never reaches the front line is not in effect.
results.recsLead: Ordered by capability prerequisites. At most three.
results.allClear: There are no unmet foundational capabilities right now. Validate this with a game day or by retaking the assessment later.
results.managerBlock: Decisions you can drive next quarter
results.engineerWeek: What you can do yourself this week
results.engineerPitch: A sentence to bring to your manager
results.shareNote: The share link contains only your role and answers, never your name or email. Recipients see a summary.
results.shareFailed: Could not copy. Copy it manually: {{url}}
results.saveFailed: We couldn't save your submission yet and will keep retrying in the background. Your results are not affected.
